caseName: United States v. Marshall & Ilsley Bank Stock Corp.
caseNameFull: UNITED STATES v. MARSHALL & ILSLEY BANK STOCK CORP. Et Al.
attorneys: Solicitor General Marshall, Assistant Attorney General Turner, Nathan Lewin, Howard E. Shapiro and Herbert G. Schoepke for the United States., Maxwell H. Herriott and Louis Quarles for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is reversed. Section 1.1 (e) of the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended, 80 Stat. 241; United States v. First City National Bank of Houston, 386 U. S. 361.
